title: Tokito component YOLO model generations
scope: Component recognition experiments only; board-family detection/classification models are separate tasks.
parameter_count_method: Counted directly from each checkpoint with Ultralytics 8.4.175.

generations.name: PCB-Vision component box smoke
generations.primary_scope: PCB-Vision held-out candidate-box test split; labels are connected-region proposals, not reviewed instance boxes.

primary_counts.note: Ultralytics detector metrics; raw detection matching counts not recorded in report.

generations.primary_metric_validity: Split is image-disjoint, but candidate boxes are noisy semantic connected regions; not a Tokito component accuracy estimate.

generations.name: Partial component diagnostic
generations.task: Instance segmentation with ignore-aware partial labels
generations.primary_scope: Four same-specimen partial validation frames; audited reviewed regions only, confidence 0.25, mask IoU 0.5.
generations.primary_metric_validity: Not independent full-scene accuracy; unreviewed pixels and instances are ignored.
generations.alternate_scope: Same four partial validation frames at confidence 0.01.

generations.name: Component segmentation v2 candidate
generations.primary_scope: External PCB-Vision connected-region audit at confidence 0.25 and mask IoU 0.5; partial masks/proposals, not exhaustive instance truth.
generations.primary_metric_validity: Diagnostic only; explicitly invalid for general accuracy claims or production readiness.
generations.alternate_scope: Tokito partial-mask audit at confidence 0.25 and mask IoU 0.5.

notes: Image split counts refer to unique image records; crop variants are excluded from these three component experiments.

Generations 1–3 use different tasks, datasets, class taxonomies, and evaluation rules. The plotted precision/recall points show reported diagnostics and must not be read as a controlled benchmark or causal improvement curve.
The v2 dataset includes 53 PCB-Vision images (33 train, 9 validation, 11 test) plus 17 Tokito partial-mask images (14 train, 3 validation). There is no Tokito local test split.

A later v2 run report exists with checkpoint hash 6e6ea32c41c469b2acbfb5abe6da60bd00c24146842698748328577ebd43ce29, different from the current published file hash. It is kept out of the generation comparison because the weights do not match the repo artifact; its report says external P/R 0.762/0.316 and local P/R 1.000/0.185, also both invalid partial-region diagnostics.
The complete-visible ESP-12E frame is part of training and cannot be used as a held-out score. No generation has a full-board, exhaustive-instance, independent Tokito test set.
None of these component models is production-ready; the current Tokito review backlog has zero exhaustive, ordinary-YOLO-ready frames.
